resources.string: Brightness across the frame, left to right. The top line, 100, is clipped white; the bottom is black.
Colour in the frame: the angle is the hue and the distance from the centre the saturation. The diagonal line marks skin tones.
How much of the frame falls in each exposure zone right now, from crushed black to clipped highlights, and the thresholds that set the zones.
How many pixels sit at each brightness, from black on the left to white on the right.
The signal the scopes read. SDR est.: an SDR estimate from the camera preview, close to but not the recorded file. SDR: the Rec.709 picture. OC-Log2: the LOG signal being recorded.
